title: Apps can check API keys without generating anything
summary:
Apps gained a way to check API keys, while image editing, Claude fallbacks, and authentication errors got less confusing.

A new GET /api/account/key endpoint lets apps validate a key and inspect its expiry, permissions, remaining Pollen budget, and rate-limit status. Authentication errors are clearer too: invalid or missing keys return distinct guidance, while rate-limited requests return 429 instead of looking like bad keys.

Klein 4B’s editing endpoint now takes prompt and settings in query parameters and up to 10 base64 reference images as a JSON array, matching Klein 9B and the existing TypeScript client.

When a Claude fallback uses Vertex AI or Bedrock, remote image URLs are converted to base64 before the request, preventing image inputs from failing on those routes.

highlights.title: Check API key status
highlights.text: Apps can use `GET /api/account/key` to validate a key and inspect its expiry and permissions without making a generation request. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).
